title: ResNet50 novelty scoring with and without PCA
scope: Exploratory retrospective benchmark on the project dataset
unit: Filename-derived scan group, not a verified patient ID

method.features: Mean saved ImageNet ResNet50 embedding across crops in each scan group
method.score: One minus cosine similarity to the nearest reference training group
method.threshold: 90th percentile of held-out glioma calibration scores
method.centering: Subtract the glioma training mean and keep all dimensions
method.pca: 64 centered components fit on glioma training groups only
method.note: All branches use the same train, calibration and test groups and scoring rule. Centering alone alters the cosine geometry, so differences between full and PCA features cannot be attributed to reducing dimensions alone. The original grayscale autoencoder experiment used a different representation, split and scorer. This benchmark does not establish performance on new scanners.
